articles.summary: Dungeons & Dragons team unionizes with the Magic: The Gathering team, Star Wars DnD will get its own dedicated adventure set in the OT, Dark Sun’s revival includes a graphic novel, and Shadowrun is set to release a rules light version next month.
articles.title: DnD Team Unionizes, Dark Sun Graphic Novel, Shadowrun Rules Light – TTRPG News 10/9/2026

articles.summary: WotC brings on a new DnD dev while letting go of a community staple, Renegade loses the World of Darkness but keeps Transformers, a modern Ravenloft setting is teased, and DnD creators rolled a giant d20 down a hill.
articles.title: ‍DnD Staff Shakeup, Renegade Loses White Wolf, Giant D20 Roll – TTRPG News 10/2/2026
